sql.query: SELECT t.id tenantId,t.tenantType,t.lifecycleStatus,t.accessStartDate,t.accessEndDate,t.retentionEndDate,t.cleanupEligibleDate,CAST(t.isActive=1 AND t.lifecycleStatus NOT IN ('closed','suspended') AND (t.accessStartDate IS NULL OR t.accessStartDate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS UNSIGNED) canAccess,CAST(t.isActive=1 AND t.lifecycleStatus='active' AND (t.accessStartDate IS NULL OR t.accessStartDate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (t.accessEndDate IS NULL OR t.accessEndDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS UNSIGNED) canWrite,CAST(t.isActive=1 AND t.tenantType='demo' AND t.lifecycleStatus='active' AND (t.accessStartDate IS NULL OR t.accessStartDate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (t.accessEndDate IS NULL OR t.accessEndDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS UNSIGNED) isActiveDemo,CAST(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_users u WHERE u.id=:userId AND u.isActive=1 AND u.isPlatformAdmin=1) AS UNSIGNED) isPlatformAdmin FROM tbl_tenants t WHERE t.id=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants ut WHERE ut.tenantId=t.id AND ut.userId=:membershipUser AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active') LIMIT 1
